# Quizlet

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 12 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Study-product marketing: twilight promo bar, white sticky nav, pill buttons, sunken search field, 24px feature tiles.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Login and signup were opened. No email, password, birthday, phone or card was submitted. Themes: light, dark.

Public signed-out surfaces of quizlet.com, measured on 19 November 2026 in the T3 Code preview browser. Pages: the marketing home, the login page, the signup page, and About. The account stayed signed out. No email, password, birthday, phone or card was submitted. Themes read: light (`body.theme-default`, painted) and night (`body.theme-night`, stylesheet only). Viewport: 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, devicePixelRatio 2.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Night colors are stylesheet declarations on `body.theme-night`, not a painted page. This Mac reported `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, and the site stayed on `theme-default`.

Hover, pressed and disabled colors are stylesheet rules. They were not painted.

The homepage h1 computed color is rgb(0, 0, 0). Login and About headings computed gray-800. The black is recorded in raw/readings.json and is not a token.

Two feature-tile fills, rgb(217, 255, 204) and rgb(18, 193, 203), are not steps on the named scales. The teacher band rgb(219, 223, 255) is not a named step either.

The modal overlay's computed background was transparent while its rule targets `--scrim300-scrim300`. The entrance animation had not painted, and the preview pane was not producing frames.

The viewport was 1169 CSS pixels wide. It is not a 1440 or 390 capture.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the twilight pill for the main action.** Log in and Sign up for free are #4255ff, white text, radius 200px, weight 600.
- **Keep the page on gray-200 and the nav on white.** Body is #f6f7fb. The sticky nav is #ffffff, 64px.
- **Fields are sunken, not outlined, until focus.** Fill #f6f7fb, radius 8px, 2px transparent border. Focus border is #a8b1ff.
- **Secondary actions use twilight-100.** Teachers is #edefff with #4255ff text, same pill radius.
- **Do not invent a night screen from the light page.** Night pairs live on `body.theme-night` and were not painted here.
- **Do not treat the feature-tile greens as scale steps.** Record Lecture uses twilight-500. Study Guides and Flashcards use one-off fills.
